app.title: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
app.author: thclpr
app.description: A command‑line and GUI application that separates vocal and instrumental stems from music tracks using a lightweight AI model.
proposed_tests: Execute `stemdeck separate --input test.mp3 --output out/` and verify output files exist
Measure the time taken for a 3‑minute audio file
Run the GUI mode with a sample track and check that the UI loads and displays separation results
Compare the loudness of the separated stems with the original to ensure no clipping
